## Concept-entry quality

Complete this section for new or substantially revised atlas entries.

- [ ] The functional alias explains what the eponym itself does not.
- [ ] The intuitive explanation is understandable without specialist context.
- [ ] The formal definition states assumptions and defines symbols.
- [ ] AI applications are concrete and current.
- [ ] Historical claims and attribution caveats are supported by reliable sources.
- [ ] Related concepts, prerequisites, and common confusions are linked or named.
- [ ] Mathematical notation, names, dates, and citations were checked.
